package main

// Credential-free stdio fixture. It implements no network, auth or model API.
import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func publish(name, value string) {
	p := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), name)
	_ = os.WriteFile(p+".tmp", []byte(value), 0600)
	_ = os.Rename(p+".tmp", p)
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "--pipe-child" {
		for {
			time.Sleep(time.Hour)
		}
	}
	mode := "success"
	directory := ""
	for i := 1; i+1 < len(os.Args); i++ {
		if os.Args[i] == "-m" {
			mode = os.Args[i+1]
		}
		if os.Args[i] == "-C" {
			directory = os.Args[i+1]
		}
	}
	signal.Ignore(syscall.SIGPIPE)
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "fixture-private-secret-canary")
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), 65536)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var r struct {
			ID     int            `json:"id"`
			Method string         `json:"method"`
			Params map[string]any `json:"params"`
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &r) != nil {
			os.Exit(10)
		}
		if r.Method == "initialized" {
			continue
		}
		if mode == "held_pipe" {
			term := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
			signal.Notify(term, syscall.SIGTERM)
			child := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "--pipe-child")
			child.Env = os.Environ()
			child.Stdout = os.Stdout
			child.Stderr = os.Stderr
			if child.Start() != nil {
				os.Exit(11)
			}
			publish("child.pid", strconv.Itoa(child.Process.Pid))
			publish("ready", "yes")
			<-term
			_ = child.Wait()
			return
		}
		if mode == "ignore_term" {
			signal.Ignore(syscall.SIGTERM)
			publish("ready", "yes")
			for {
				time.Sleep(time.Hour)
			}
		}
		if mode == "partial" {
			fmt.Print(`{"id":1,"result":`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "oversize" {
			fmt.Println(strings.Repeat("x", (2<<20)+2))
			return
		}
		if mode == "deep" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":1,"result":{"x":` + strings.Repeat("[", 40) + "0" + strings.Repeat("]", 40) + `}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "nodes" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":1,"result":{"x":[` + strings.Repeat("0,", 32768) + `0]}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "large_notification" {
			fmt.Println(`{"method":"synthetic/notice","params":{"private":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 65536) + `"}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "duplicate" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":1,"id":1,"result":{}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "wrong_id" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":99,"result":{}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "remote_error" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":1,"error":{"message":"fixture-private-secret-canary"}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "server_request" {
			fmt.Println(`{"id":"server-owned","method":"tools/call","params":{}}`)
			return
		}
		if mode == "early_eof" {
			return
		}
		if mode == "notifications" || mode == "notification_flood" {
			n := 1
			if mode == "notification_flood" {
				n = 17
			}
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				fmt.Println(`{"method":"synthetic/notice","params":{"private":"fixture-private-secret-canary"}}`)
			}
		}
		var result any
		switch r.ID {
		case 1:
			result = map[string]any{"userAgent": "synthetic-no-auth-client"}
		case 2:
			cwd, _ := os.Getwd()
			provider := "openai"
			if cwd != directory || os.Getenv("HOME") == "" {
				provider = "scope-mismatch"
			}
			result = map[string]any{"config": map[string]any{"model_provider": provider, "openai_base_url": "https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex", "chatgpt_base_url": "https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/", "forced_login_method": nil, "forced_chatgpt_workspace_id": nil}}
		case 3:
			result = map[string]any{"requirements": nil}
		case 4:
			if mode == "no_auth" {
				result = map[string]any{"account": nil, "requiresOpenaiAuth": true, "workspaceRouting": nil}
			} else {
				result = map[string]any{"account": map[string]any{"type": "chatgpt", "email": "fixture-private-secret-canary", "planType": "plus"}, "requiresOpenaiAuth": true, "workspaceRouting": map[string]any{"chatgptAccountId": "fixture-private-secret-canary", "backendOrigin": "https://chatgpt.com", "accountRoutingOverride": "NO_CONSTRAINT"}}
			}
		default:
			os.Exit(12)
		}
		if json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"id": r.ID, "result": result}) != nil {
			return
		}
	}
	if mode == "nonzero_exit" {
		os.Exit(12)
	}
}
